parent_protocol.reason_for_new_version: Replace the one-sided reciprocal-max Foldseek rule with reciprocal-min global fold isolation, bind the completed split/cache/US-align authorities, and freeze the executable SAbDab2 training matrix.

project.name: FrameContact
project.title: Geometry-aware Partner-specific Antibody-Antigen Modeling under Structural Novelty
project.confirmatory_claim: On reciprocal-min-TM-isolated antigen folds, an explicitly partner-conditioned contact model ranks the cognate antibody above matched non-cognate antibodies using interaction-only residue-pair evidence.

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.asep_role: external development benchmark and engineering validation only
evidence_boundary_at_freeze.prohibited_claim: Neither AsEP development results nor monomer-only epitope/paratope results are confirmatory evidence for SAbDab2 structural generalization or partner specificity.

data.development_source: Authenticated SAbDab2 structure, ESM2-650M, and exact residue-pair contact cohorts

split.name: sabdab2_antigen_fold_reciprocal_min_v3_1
split.structural_edge_rule: min(Foldseek query-normalized TM-score, Foldseek target-normalized TM-score) >= 0.50
split.policy_component_rule: transitive closure of structural hard edges plus exact PDB assembly, antigen sequence, and antibody sequence equality
split.test_policy: The test role cannot be loaded for architecture, objective, checkpoint, calibration, threshold, intervention choice, seed selection, or failure analysis.

reciprocal_partner_panel.selection_time: before fitting from identifiers and task-label-free partner metadata

hypothesis.primary: For the same antigen, the cognate antibody has a positive interaction-only compatibility margin over 31 frozen matched non-cognate antibodies on the sealed antigen-fold test role.
hypothesis.required_reciprocal: For the same antibody, the cognate antigen has a positive interaction-only compatibility margin over the reciprocal frozen panel.
hypothesis.mechanistic: Local-frame intra-chain geometry improves monomer features and an explicit pair-contact representation gates bidirectional cross-chain information flow without directly subtracting coordinates from unaligned monomers.
hypothesis.null: Cognate and matched non-cognate partners have equal expected interaction-only compatibility after cluster weighting.

primary_endpoint.name: fixed_antigen_cognate_antibody_interaction_margin
primary_endpoint.pair_score: mean sigmoid of the largest max(1,ceil(0.01*candidate_pair_count)) interaction-only pair logits
primary_endpoint.success_rule: the two-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero

required_reciprocal_endpoint.name: fixed_antibody_cognate_antigen_interaction_margin
required_reciprocal_endpoint.success_rule: reported with a 10000-replicate cluster bootstrap and cannot replace a failed primary endpoint

training_objective.contact: class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong pairs are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum of the two validation cluster-weighted directional interaction-only margins; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.reporting: report every seed and a frozen five-seed ensemble without suppressing failures

marginals: epitope and paratope pooled and mean per-complex AUPRC

required_interventions: sequence-preserving coordinate Gaussian noise at 0.10, 0.25, and 0.50 angstrom
independent antibody and antigen global SE(3) transforms

secondary_evaluation.temporal_split: run only after antigen-fold development decisions are frozen
secondary_evaluation.asep: official development/test policy followed independently; no SAbDab2 test tuning
secondary_evaluation.chimera: canonical epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design is downstream and cannot be inferred from classification

failure_rules: A residue AUPRC gain without a positive interaction-only partner margin does not support partner specificity.
A total-contact margin with a non-positive interaction-only margin is a unary-propensity shortcut failure.
Attention weights are diagnostic, not contact predictions, unless scored through the explicit contact head.
One seed, development-only performance, or an opened test used for decisions cannot support the confirmatory claim.
The reciprocal-min Foldseek split is described as a declared operational fold criterion, not proof of zero remote homology.
